title: They Work, but Beware of the Thumb
text:
They Work, but Beware of the Thumb. Kitchen essentials are many and if you frequently use your oven, you need a good set of pot holders and oven mitts. We have a few in my household but are always in need of replacements, as many of them tend to wear out. This ongoing need was enough to convince me to get my hands on DII Cotton Heat Resistant Kitchen Pot Holder and Oven Mitt Set.

With this purchase, you get a pair of items to keep your hands protected from the heat- one mitt, and one pot holder. The black and white design is good for my kitchen because our appliances are all stainless steel or black. And the material is good because, since it is entirely made from cotton, it feels soft and is completely machine washable, which are both plusses.

We have used and generally liked these two kitchen helpers, but there is one issue I have with the mitt, and it is one I see that other reviewers have stated as well. It’s the thumb in the mitt- it isn’t long enough to make it as practical as it should be. Because it is short, I find I cannot grip a hot pan as securely as I should be able to. I haven’t burned myself or anything like that, but I find that, in order to feel safer and more secure, when I use the mitt I will often use the pot holder along with it, on my other hand, while I carry the hot pan or cookie sheet from the oven. With other mitts that have longer thumbs, I can easily pick up most hot pans with only the mitt. Not a huge issue, I suppose. But it bugs me because this seems like something that the manufacturer should have realized was a flaw and immediately corrected.

This mitt and pot holder set is attractive and matches my kitchen, but due to the issue stated above, I can only give them an average rating overall. If you have very small hands, they might be just fine but for the rest of us, the short thumb will likely be a problem, so keep that in mind if you decide to buy.
